questions.question: 这一步最希望帮你决定什么？
questions.trigger: Output ambiguous; infer request and resumed state.

questions.question: 目前应先探索问题、审计已有方法结果，还是处理实际拒稿？
questions.trigger: Exactly one route clarification only when discovered assets leave origin unknown/mixed.

questions.question: 更希望得到新方法、理论、测量/数据、系统，还是有价值的负结果？
questions.trigger: Contribution preference changes slate; accept open choice.

questions.question: 哪一个问题或约束是必须保留的？
questions.trigger: Broad exploration cannot form a useful frame; distinguish real constraint from attachment to a tool.

questions.question: 你现有的哪项专长或独特资源最值得利用？
questions.trigger: Asset/strengths not inferable and alters feasibility or direction.

questions.question: 目标会场、年份、track 是哪一个？
questions.trigger: Rules change current deliverable; infer manuscript/template.

questions.question: 这一阶段的截止日期是什么？
questions.trigger: Schedule changes must-run scope; do not ask just to fill form.

questions.question: 即使结果为负，什么知识或产物仍算有价值？
questions.trigger: Stop/measurement/diagnostic routes need preferences.

questions.question: 什么发现会让你停止或换方向？
questions.trigger: Research decision preference is absent; later scientific threshold separately frozen.

questions.question: 你最在意哪个真实场景中的失败？
questions.trigger: Natural consequence unclear; inspect task logs/examples before asking.

questions.question: 哪种相互竞争的解释最值得优先区分？
questions.trigger: Existing facts permit several mechanisms and prioritization affects cheap test.

questions.question: 还有什么反常现象或本应出现却没有出现的现象？
questions.trigger: Optional divergent prompt when current framing is narrow; not an intake blocker.

questions.question: 目前哪个简单办法最强、最值得公平复现？
questions.trigger: Literature and assets do not settle baseline family.

questions.question: 哪个未解决的后果最值得付出新方法的复杂度？
questions.trigger: Several residual failures; select value, not only score opportunity.

questions.question: 哪个独有预测最能把机制与替代解释区分开？
questions.trigger: Mechanism ambiguous after code/paper audit.

questions.question: 什么观察会直接推翻这条想法？
questions.trigger: A falsifier cannot be inferred; optional guidance can draft alternatives.

questions.question: 有没有未公开或正在进行的最接近工作需要纳入比较？
questions.trigger: Published search insufficient for user-specific knowledge; no secrets requested.

questions.question: 当信息增益、成功概率、影响与成本冲突时，哪项优先？
questions.trigger: Ranking tradeoff changes shortlist; retain dissent/uncertainty.

questions.question: 是否保留一个风险较高、但无论正负都很有信息的候选？
questions.trigger: All shortlisted items are safe/incremental; optional preference.

questions.question: 原问题仍有意义时，更愿意继续、换机制，还是停止？
questions.trigger: Collision/evidence transition has concrete candidates and consequences.

questions.question: 预期变化发生在流程的哪个位置？
questions.trigger: Method's intervention point absent; inspect implementation first.

questions.question: 每个组件分别应该解决哪一项已观察到的失败？
questions.trigger: Module list has no responsibility/mechanism mapping.

questions.question: 这项推导最关键、也最可能被现实违反的假设是什么？
questions.trigger: Assumptions not explicit; offer drafted assumption ledger for correction.

questions.question: 推理时真正可用的信息是哪一种？
questions.trigger: Training/test/retrieval/feedback access remains ambiguous.

questions.question: 理论结果要解释哪一项可观察行为或边界？
questions.trigger: Mathematical contribution objective unclear; theorem not forced onto empirical work.

questions.question: 要把方法嵌入哪个现有接口或工作流？
questions.trigger: Integration requirement blocks algorithm contract.

questions.question: 最需要保证哪个资源上限？
questions.trigger: Latency/storage/calls/compute tradeoff unclear; exact independent limits are separate slots.

questions.question: 哪个尺度或分布变化最可能让方法失效？
questions.trigger: Boundary-test priorities not settled by evidence.

questions.question: 最有力的组件替代方案是什么？
questions.trigger: Replacement/necessity test ambiguous after literature audit.

questions.question: 当前先修实现、基线资格，还是继续方法开发？
questions.trigger: Observed failed sanity/baseline creates a real branch; show root-cause evidence first.

questions.question: 开发循环还可使用多少时间？
questions.trigger: Bounded tuning/debug budget missing; costs already known retained.

questions.question: 哪个数据分区可以用于开发调参？
questions.trigger: Discovery split not determined from dataset/config.

questions.question: 已经看过哪些结果或数据？
questions.trigger: Provenance cannot establish exposure; governs evidence eligibility.

questions.question: 哪个未触碰的数据或外部重复可用于确认？
questions.trigger: Holdout/independent test unresolved; do not manufacture confirmation.

questions.question: 允许调的参数范围是什么？
questions.trigger: Search space/result-affecting development scope not fixed.

questions.question: 最小有意义的改善是多少？
questions.trigger: Task consequence does not determine threshold; not picked after results.

questions.question: 确认需要多大的精度，或能接受多大的不确定性？
questions.trigger: Run count/statistical plan not settled; do not default blindly to three seeds.

questions.question: 这份具体确认协议是否准确表达你的决策标准？
questions.trigger: Final reviewable freeze with baseline/control/split/metric/budget/eligibility/decision rules; one coherent artifact confirmation.

questions.question: 是否执行这份已准备好的具体运行计划？
questions.trigger: Only if user/host authority is still required; never re-ask authorized unchanged actions.

questions.question: 对于这次无法判定，愿意付出哪项代价消除不确定性？
questions.trigger: Clean INCONCLUSIVE with missing evidence, cost and alternatives.

questions.question: 哪一条中心主张是完整实验必须证明的？
questions.trigger: Dominant claim genuinely ambiguous; inspect approved Atom/manuscript first.

questions.question: 哪条反主张最可能解释表面收益？
questions.trigger: Claim-driven roadmap needs compute/parameters/data-access alternative.

questions.question: 哪个外部复现或模型最能检验泛化？
questions.trigger: Independent evidence choice changes design; no arbitrary benchmark wishlist.

questions.question: 哪个消融或替换最能证明必要性？
questions.trigger: Responsibility already mapped but discriminating control unclear.

questions.question: 应优先验证哪些自然边界或失败人群？
questions.trigger: More than one consequential regime; retain complete planned population.

questions.question: 哪个质量—成本取舍对使用者最重要？
questions.trigger: Efficiency endpoint unclear; measure actual cost under quality guardrail.

questions.question: 现有实验应作为回顾审计，还是规划新的前瞻确认？
questions.trigger: Mature/rejected project evidence mode ambiguous; never relabel seen results.

questions.question: 当前优先需要独立诊断、修复计划，还是转投？
questions.trigger: Requested rejection output unclear; reviewer packet inspected first.

questions.question: 哪些补证据最可能改变审稿决定、且仍在时间预算内？
questions.trigger: Issue cards and estimated remedies ready; priorities differ.

questions.question: 回复中哪些技术判断还需要作者确认？
questions.trigger: Author-only facts not inferable; grounded draft prepared first.

questions.question: 若核心证据无法修复，选择负结果、测量、缩限复用，还是停止？
questions.trigger: Actual KILL/failed evidence and consequences available; do not save novelty by shrinking importance.

questions.question: 下一目标 venue 是哪个？
questions.trigger: Concrete retargeting changes rules; not asked during unrelated diagnosis.

method_routes.title: Real-condition baseline gap
method_routes.question: Which baseline assumption fails in a real setting?
branches: Distribution shift, occlusion or input quality
Scarce labels, missing modality or temporal drift
Natural prevalence and a smallest intervention
method_routes.check: Reproduce a strong baseline, measure the residual failure, test one discriminating change.

method_routes.title: Complementary composition
method_routes.question: Why should these mechanisms work together?
branches: Add, replace, decouple or gate a component
Map information and responsibility at the interface
Check interaction under matched budgets
method_routes.check: Compare A, B, A+B and a qualified simple replacement when complementarity is claimed.

method_routes.title: Experiment-driven discovery
method_routes.question: What explains an unexpected pattern?
branches: Negative/null results and subgroup contrasts
Seed instability, saturation or train/test mismatch
Quality-cost crossover and failure clusters
method_routes.check: Write competing explanations and test a new prediction on fresh confirmation data.

method_routes.title: Cross-domain mechanism transfer
method_routes.question: Where has the underlying constraint been solved?
branches: Translate the root cause into abstract variables
Map donor assumptions to the new task
Check simple transfer and negative transfer
method_routes.check: Verify the interface and compare a strong in-domain alternative.

method_routes.title: Mathematical derivation
method_routes.question: Which missing factor or assumption changes behavior?
branches: Objectives, conditioning and normalization
Identifiability, expressivity or optimization
Limiting cases, counterexamples and error bounds
method_routes.check: Derive a computable prediction with explicit information and assumptions.

method_routes.title: Efficiency & system constraints
method_routes.question: Where is the end-to-end bottleneck?
branches: Memory, communication, latency and serving
Caching, batching, sparsity and precision
Simplify or share costly state and computation
method_routes.check: Measure the complete quality-cost frontier, not parameter count alone.

method_routes.title: Data & evaluation redesign
method_routes.question: Does the instrument measure the desired outcome?
branches: Metric blind spots and annotation disagreement
Natural coverage, sampling and contamination
Defined censuses and meaningful diagnostic regimes
method_routes.check: Validate the task, denominator and evaluator before claiming a new gap.

method_routes.title: Simplification & unification
method_routes.question: Can a simpler explanation preserve the useful behavior?
branches: Delete unnecessary modules
Replace a complex mechanism with a simple primitive
Unify related methods through shared assumptions
method_routes.check: Run deletion/replacement controls against the strongest simple explanation.
